texts: Tap a question to see its answer.
What happens when I pause or stop?
Tap a question to see its answer.
Paper mode simulates copied actions with a virtual $200 starting balance. It does not place real orders or debit a wallet. Demo results help you learn the flow, but cannot predict live results.
What happens when I pause or stop?
Tap a question to see its answer.
Every new copied action is checked against global risk rules and this trader’s limits. Budget, position size, daily spend or an old signal can block an entry. See the reason in Activity.
What happens when I pause or stop?
Tap a question to see its answer.

Your entry time and price can differ from the trader’s. Liquidity, fees, partial fills and skipped actions can also change PnL. Your copying history covers your own period, not the trader’s whole record.
What happens when I pause or stop?
Tap a question to see its answer.
What happens when I pause or stop?
Pause stops new copied entries. Existing positions stay visible and are not closed automatically. Stop ends future copying; closing open positions is a separate action.
